action_items: No code fixes required. Backend and frontend behave as specified in the review request.

Optional nice-to-have: on the Btn component (src/components/ui.tsx), the testID currently sits on the Pressable; when the button is disabled it still renders but Playwright occasionally fails to locate 'save-client-button' via data-testid immediately after an autoFocus+fill sequence. Current tests work around it via get_by_placeholder+text. Consider also forwarding testID to a wrapping View and keeping it stable to make e2e tests more robust.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single file ~460 lines - acceptable now but will benefit from splitting into routers (auth/products/collaborators/clients/orders/dashboard) if it grows.
All MongoDB queries properly exclude _id with projection {'_id': 0} and user password_hash is stripped from /api/me - good.
JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME are read from env with no insecure defaults - good.

Order creation uses atomic computation + single collaborator update; it is NOT inside a Mongo session/transaction, so a crash between inserting the order and updating the stock would leave them out of sync. Low risk for single-user app but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all screens render, all primary navigations work, create-client/create-order smoke flow validated up to submit; final submit-order click not programmatically confirmed due to Playwright testID resolution timing on Btn after autoFocus, not a product bug)

seed_data_creation: Suite creates (and cleans up) a TEST_Colaborator_X, TEST_Client_A, and a few orders. The UI run also creates a TEST_UI_Client under MOD SHOP SRL that persists in the preview DB (minor, can be deleted via UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py. Run with: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_backend_api.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Important: the shared pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, which splits classes across workers. The suite shares state via a module-level dict across classes, so always pass `-n 0` to run sequentially. BASE URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. For frontend: Btn component on save flows is clickable but its testID can lag one tick after fill+autoFocus; prefer get_by_text('SALVEAZA CLIENT') or placeholder-based selectors when writing new UI tests, or add `await page.wait_for_timeout(400)` after fill.
